intervention_execution.claim: The new intervention must execute an entity-pair-conditioned Hermitian token-graph propagation and inject its valid-key path probabilities into the existing relation-attention logit path.

intended_intermediate.claim: The intended intermediate is cross-step interference among alternate token paths, not another independent query/key score, covariance scalar, or value gate.

observable_output.claim: The screen must measure whether coherent path probabilities change valid-token attention and downstream relation logits; aggregate historical reports do not yet establish this causal chain.

task_utility.claim: Task utility is unknown until a predeclared held-out primary metric is compared against the same disabled baseline under the shared gates.

primary_explanation.statement: Historical quantum-attention improvements are small and inconsistent; where QK transport gave the clearest single-seed gain, its matched classical counterpart was both stronger and much faster. The new candidate should test whether path interference adds information beyond classical multi-hop transport rather than assume it does.

alternative_explanations.statement: The reference-cohort metric profile may reflect backbone, training-budget, preprocessing, or loss differences rather than an attention-mechanism limitation.
Q-CEASC's three-seed mean is positive but uncertain; context-conditioned support may help only in some seeds or classes, and class-level evidence is not yet causal.
A Q-ECPA result could be produced by ordinary graph diffusion, entity lexical shortcuts, or a stronger residual interface rather than coherence.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Whether multi-path phase interference changes relation attention usefully beyond dephased transitions and a parameter/compute-matched classical multi-hop graph control.
discriminating_measurement.measurement: Freeze a short-sequence screen and compare disabled, coherent, same-Hamiltonian dephased, matched classical propagation, random phase, original QK, and entity-pair permutation controls; record attention/logit deltas, gradients, declared metrics, and full train/valid/test selected-case tensors.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: A positive predeclared held-out primary-metric delta versus disabled passes the project utility gate; coherent-versus-dephased/classical differences separately identify mechanism support.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: If phase-cycle terms or intervention gradients vanish, or the coherent condition is equivalent to dephased/classical controls, stop coherence attribution; an ordinary toy null remains inconclusive unless a fatal defect is found.

forbidden_rescue_variants: Retune MQIC shared-key/query covariance rank, scale, or centering without a new causal pathway.
Promote Q-EPVG auxiliary ZZ-score or another post-hoc metric after its primary multi-seed result failed.
Change QK depth/gain/readout only while preserving the same independently scored-pair mechanism.
Treat Q-CEASC per-key near-null as a reason to keep selecting favorable seeds or classes.

positive_carryovers.mechanism: QK coherent transport produced the clearest positive single-seed quantum-vs-disabled macro-F1 change (+0.3833 pp), but its matched classical condition was higher and about ten times faster.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Carry forward only the testable transport hypothesis; preserve matched classical superiority and runtime as adverse evidence, not as an attribution claim.

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Original Q-CEASC adds context-conditioned support outside a frozen action span and has positive single-seed utility, while its three-seed paired interval crosses zero.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Use as a lower-priority alternate and retain its seed uncertainty; do not claim reproducibility or graft its action-span mechanism into Q-ECPA without a new hypothesis.

selected_candidate.title: Q-ECPA: Entity-Conditioned Coherent Path Attention
selected_candidate.causal_difference: Replace independent pair-score transport with entity-conditioned complex phases on a fixed sparse token graph, so alternate multi-hop paths interfere before their probabilities become a residual in existing attention logits.
selected_candidate.discriminating_measurement: Compare coherent multi-step transition probabilities against same-H dephasing and matched classical multi-hop attention, with fixed entity inputs/support, nonzero cycle flux, finite gradients, and complete selected-case tensor lineage.
selected_candidate.success_gate: Toy/preflight only after theory and lifecycle review. Formal single-seed collaborator run only after toy passes; any positive predeclared held-out primary delta vs disabled is L1 under shared gates. Quantum-over-classical is a separate attribution claim and is not required for L1.
selected_candidate.kill_condition: Stop if the implemented phase is only a node rephasing with zero loop flux, gradients/intervention are identically zero, tensor/attention lineage cannot be recorded, or code does not implement the stated mechanism. If coherent and controls match, withdraw coherence attribution; a small toy null alone is not fatal.
selected_candidate.authorization_boundary: This record recommends design only. It authorizes neither implementation nor experiment. Full Re-TACRED runs remain collaborator-only; any later R2/R3 code requires project theory/lifecycle review and complete case-study capture before handoff.

trace_adequacy.selection_rule: Predeclare split-stratified train/valid/test example IDs without inspecting candidate outcomes; freeze before any run.
trace_adequacy.target_boundary: The entire raw-example-to-tokenization-to-embedding-to-graph-phase-to-propagation-to-attention-to-relation-logit path, initial/best/final checkpoint, plus matched dephased/classical controls.
missing_stages: raw example, entity spans, and token/subword alignment
embedding and Q/K/V representations with masks
graph edges, weights, degrees, entity-conditioned phase and Hamiltonian real/imaginary tensors
unitary/path state per propagation step and coherent transition probabilities
base/adjusted attention logits and probabilities, context, relation logits/probabilities/loss
intervention parameter gradients and checkpoint/split lineage

limitations: Historical studies use different backbones, budgets, protocols, and some obsolete metadata; only within-study paired deltas are interpreted.
Reference cohort is single seed and heterogeneous, not a paired attention ablation or global SOTA certificate.
No exhaustive literature or novelty audit; closest-work check used public arXiv abstracts only.
No observed Q-ECPA code, toy result, full tensor trace, utility, or quantum attribution exists yet.
The unified dataset qualification link is unverified; idea status stays speculative/exploratory.
